description:
•About our brand and products

Europa Cosmetica is a global online retailer specialising in premium skincare and fragrance at highly competitive prices. We source authentic products from a global network, allowing customers to access sought-after brands often at significantly lower prices than traditional retail.

Our customers are value-driven and actively searching for the best deals on trusted, high-end products — making our brand a strong fit for performance-driven affiliates.

What makes us different

  • Highly competitive pricing on premium skincare and fragrance

  • Global fulfilment model serving USA, Europe, and Australia

  • Strong demand from price-conscious, repeat customers

  • Wide product range across luxury and hard-to-find items

  • Consistent promotions and offers that conver

👉 In short:

High intent traffic + strong price advantage = high conversion potential



How affiliates can earn


  • Competitive commission structure on all approved sales

  • High average order values in premium categories

  • Regular promotions, discounts, and seasonal campaigns

  • Opportunities for exclusive codes and performance bonuses

  • Reliable tracking and reporting through our affiliate platform


👉 Our model is built for:

  • coupon & cashback partners

  • deal and comparison sites

  • performance marketers focused on conversion



How to promote us

Affiliates perform best by leveraging:

  • Deal and coupon placements

  • “Best price” and comparison content

  • Skincare and fragrance roundups

  • Paid traffic (where permitted)

  • Email and loyalty audiences


We provide:

  • Regular promotional updates

  • Creative assets and banners

  • Support for custom campaigns



Other information

  • We operate across multiple regions (US, EU, AU)

  • Fast-growing brand with strong repeat purchase behaviour

  • Dedicated support for affiliate partners

  • Flexible collaboration opportunities for high-performing affiliates
term_and_condition:
1. Overview

By joining the Europa Cosmetica Affiliate Program, you agree to comply with the following terms. These terms are designed to protect brand integrity, ensure fair promotion, and maintain a high-quality affiliate ecosystem.


2. Commission & Attribution

  • Commission is paid on approved, completed orders only

  • Orders that are:

    • cancelled

    • refunded

    • fraudulent

    • charged back

      will not be eligible for commission


  • Attribution is based on last-click tracking unless otherwise agreed

  • We reserve the right to adjust commission rates at any time



3. Prohibited Activities (Strict Enforcement)

🚫 3.1 Brand Bidding (Paid Search)

Affiliates are strictly prohibited from bidding on:


  • “Europa Cosmetica”

  • “Europacosmetica”

  • any misspellings or variations

  • branded product + company combinations

This includes:

  • Google Ads

  • Bing Ads

  • Shopping ads

  • display campaigns

👉 Violations will result in:

  • immediate termination

  • commission reversal

  • permanent ban

🚫 3.2 Direct Linking / URL Hijacking

Affiliates may not:

  • link directly from ads to our website using affiliate links

  • use redirects that disguise traffic origin

  • impersonate our domain in display URLs



🚫 3.3 Trademark & Brand Misuse

Affiliates may not:

  • register domains containing our brand name

  • create social accounts impersonating our brand

  • use our brand in a misleading or deceptive way

🚫 3.4 Coupon Abuse

  • Affiliates may only promote valid, authorised codes

  • Publishing fake, scraped, or expired codes is prohibited

  • “Clickbait coupon” tactics are not allowed


🚫 3.5 Spam & Unsolicited Promotion

Affiliates may not:

  • send spam emails

  • use unsolicited DMs

  • post in irrelevant forums/groups

🚫 3.6 Misrepresentation

Affiliates must not:


  • claim to be official representatives

  • imply exclusivity unless agreed

  • make false product claims



4. Approved Promotion Methods

Affiliates are encouraged to use:

  • content / review sites

  • deal & coupon platforms

  • email marketing (opt-in only)

  • social media promotion

  • comparison and “best of” lists


5. Compliance Requirements

Affiliates must:

  • comply with all applicable advertising laws

  • clearly disclose affiliate relationships

  • follow FTC / ACCC / EU disclosure guidelines


6. Order Validation & Adjustments


We reserve the right to:

  • reject commissions from suspicious activity

  • reverse commissions linked to violations

  • withhold payments pending investigation



7. Termination

We may terminate any affiliate account at any time if:

  • terms are violated

  • activity is deemed harmful to the brand

  • traffic quality is poor or misleading

👉 Termination includes:

  • forfeiture of unpaid commissions related to violations



8. Modifications

We may update these terms at any time. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of any changes.


9. Contact

For questions or partnership requests:

helpdesk@europacosmetica.com
